dataSources.title: Data sources
dataSources.subtitle: Where NutriCore's nutrition data comes from, and under what terms.
dataSources.offBody: Primary source for packaged foods. The Open Food Facts database is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL); individual contents are under the Database Contents License. Product images carry their own licence terms. Cached records keep their provider id and retrieval time so they stay identifiable as OFF-derived.
dataSources.usdaBody: Optional source for generic ingredients and staple foods. USDA FoodData Central data is generally in the public domain (CC0), and is attributed here regardless.
dataSources.ownBody: Foods you create are marked as your own. AI suggestions are estimates, are calculated from resolved ingredients rather than invented totals, and are only stored after you confirm them.
dataSources.shareAlike: Redistributing a database derived from Open Food Facts may carry share-alike obligations under the ODbL. This page is operational documentation, not legal advice.
dataSources.compendiumBody: The activity library’s MET values come from the 2024 Adult Compendium. Compendium codes are retained for auditability.

hint.MODEL_TIMEOUT: The model did not answer in time. Usually a model that is too slow, a prompt that is too long, or an answer that never terminates.
hint.MODEL_UNREACHABLE: The connection to Ollama was never established. Check AI_BASE_URL and whether the worker container can reach the Ollama network.
hint.MODEL_MISSING: The configured model is not present on this Ollama instance. Pull it on the Ollama host with `ollama pull`.
hint.MODEL_HTTP_ERROR: Ollama answered with an error status. Its own log names the reason - most often not enough memory for the model.
hint.MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID: The answer was JSON but did not match the expected schema. The field paths above name the rejected values.
hint.SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: The page is larger than the 512 KB limit. Another attempt cannot change that.
hint.SOURCE_BLOCKED: The address was refused for safety: a private network, a disallowed port, or a disallowed scheme.
hint.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The page could not be retrieved - a redirect limit, a timeout, or an error status.
hint.SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE: SearXNG was unreachable or did not answer with JSON. Without source discovery no nutrition source can be found.
hint.RATE_LIMITED: NutriCore's own rate limit stopped the job. Run it again later.
hint.DATA_MISSING: A record the job needs is gone, such as a deleted recipe or food. Another attempt will not help.
hint.UNKNOWN: Not classified. The full cause chain is under “Show details”.
hint.MODEL_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED: The model was stopped at the token limit before it finished. Either the schema permits an answer that is too long, or OLLAMA_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS is too low.
hint.CONFIG_INVALID: A required setting is missing or invalid — the message names it. Check the .env of the affected container; the app and the worker need the same configuration. Another attempt will not help.
